title: Value Semantics, Memory, and Object Lifetime
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of value semantics, memory, and object lifetime in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 10: Value Semantics, Memory, and Object Lifetime. Lessons in order: Value Types Versus Reference Types; Mutability and Copy-on-Write; Identity and Equality; Automatic Reference Counting; Strong Reference Cycles; Weak and Unowned References; Memory Management in Closures; Deinitialization and Resource Cleanup; Copying, Sharing, and Ownership Concepts; Memory Layout and Representation; Unsafe Swift and Raw Memory; Memory-Safe API Design.
